general_notes: Candidates fall into five recurring presentations: (1) the painting inset in a flat frame (closest), (2) a blurred/low-res copy of the painting, (3) a tight circular vignette crop on dark that cuts the legs, (4) the character isolated on near-black with a glow halo, (5) the character isolated on light grey with an orange smear halo, plus (6) a 3D/CG re-creation that is a different character. Within each group the images looked identical or near-identical to me, so I scored them the same or within half a point. The light-background versions show edge artifacts (dark rim on the idle head, copper rim and stray line/blob in depleted, streaks on the fierce robe). The depleted target itself contains a grey rectangular patch at bottom right; I did not penalise candidates for keeping it. Uncertainty: I judged by eye at the displayed resolution, so tiny pixel differences between same-group candidates may exist that I could not see.
